scope: Meta-analysis of oxygen for simple nocturnal hypoxemia (NOD) in COPD, reporting survival, progression to long-term oxygen, and daytime PaO2.

keyRecommendations.text: Oxygen did not significantly change total mortality (RR 1.04, 95% CI 0.81–1.33) or the separately reported mortality estimate (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.58–1.31).
Progression to long-term oxygen therapy was not reduced (RR 1.07, 95% CI 0.76–1.51).
The conclusion states that oxygen can improve PaO2 but has no significant effect on survival or on progression to long-term oxygen.

clinicalBottomLine: For COPD with simple nocturnal hypoxemia, this meta-analysis does not show a survival benefit or less progression to long-term oxygen from oxygen therapy. Daytime PaO2 was higher in the oxygen groups.
notableCaveats: The LOTT trial of resting or exertional desaturation is a different question and is not the source for these items.

source.title: Prognostic value of oxygen inhalation therapy for simple nocturnal hypoxemia in COPD: a meta-analysis.
